title: Confederation (confederal arrangement)
competency: Explain confederation and compare the three state structures.

keywords.def: A loose alliance where member states keep their sovereignty and delegate some tasks to a weak central organ, like the EU.

en.text: A confederation is a loose alliance of nations. Members keep their sovereignty and can choose whether to follow a weak central organ, which depends on what they delegate. Its goals are usually common defence, postal and communication links, trade practices and cultural unity. The European Union is the book's example.
